g.text: B | Paired change: later − full window
Meal responses remain associated with CGM on separate dates
All 24 prespecified primary associations are positive with q < 0.05; the samples overlap.
Unit: full-window reference Y SD per reference SD of early meal response. Original N = 4,435 / 4,433 (MODD15); joint N = 4,136 / 4,134.
BH families: 24 primary tests in A; a separate secondary family of 24 paired contrasts in B. Full window includes later dates.
Screenshot display precision; no re-fitting or re-testing. New fixed grid definitions; MODD15 is not asserted equal to legacy iglu MODD.
